headline: Malaysian ringgit strengthens to 4.11 per dollar following Q3 GDP growth
summary: The Malaysian ringgit appreciated to 4.1100 against the U.S. dollar, supported by expansion in third-quarter gross domestic product.
why: The ringgit's valuation reflects foreign exchange liquidity, commodity export volume, and Malaysian economic performance.

impacts.name: Malaysian Ringgit
impacts.why: Higher Q3 gross domestic product growth increased demand for Malaysian currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger third-quarter gross domestic product figures attracted currency buyers to the ringgit.
